description: Register an OktaResource (OAuth2 client_credentials grant against an Okta API Service Integration) wrapping the Okta Users API for use by other components. Exposes only find/create/update/deactivate -- never delete.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

client_id_env_var.label: Client ID Env Var
client_id_env_var.description: Env var holding the Okta API Service Integration's Client ID (grant it only the okta.users.manage scope).

client_secret_env_var.label: Client Secret Env Var
client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the Service Integration's Client Secret.

token_path.label: Token Path
token_path.description: Token endpoint path, relative to org_url.

name: Okta Resource
